collectionGroupsMeaning: collectionGroups are human-curated discovery routes inherited along the first verified related-artist path, never provider genre assertions. Parent and seed IDs preserve the path.
limitations: Public metadata snapshot, not a global or exhaustive music catalog.
Deezer track IDs are deduplicated. Separate releases/remasters/live versions can represent the same composition.
distinctArtistTitlePairs also deduplicates exact NFKC/case/space-normalized title within a primary artist, but does not prove distinct compositions.
Artist top is empirically capped at 100; index=100 yielded no second page. Repeated top pagination is not used.
collectionGroups are human-curated discovery routes inherited along the first verified related-artist path, never provider genre assertions. Parent and seed IDs preserve the path.
The unreliable /genre/{id}/artists path is excluded. artistGenres is empty and no listening/quality labels are invented.
popularity is provider rank, not musical quality. Artist top and related discovery introduce popularity and graph-neighborhood bias.
previewAvailable reports URL presence when fetched. Preview URLs are stripped; no audio is downloaded or analyzed.
V1 records are reused with original collection provenance. Newly discovered catalog availability is time/region dependent.
